# Apocalypse of Peter — Chapter 17
**Agent:** SOPHIA (Consensus)
**Source:** Akhmim Fragment / Ethiopic MS, Apocalypse of Peter 17

---

## Consensus Translation

*[The Ascension. The cloud of light. Moses and Elijah weep. The final commission.]*

1. While he was still speaking, he was taken up into the heavens, and a great cloud of light received him. And we saw written upon that cloud: "This is my beloved Son in whom I am well pleased; he has kept my commandments."

2. We remained there weeping and sorrowful, because we could no longer see him.

3. Moses and Elijah, who had also gone up with him into the heavens, heard the voice of God saying to them: "Go to my holy mountain and remain there until the day of my coming, which will be fulfilled in the generation that is yet to come."

4. We fell upon our faces and praised God and the Lord. And we watched the cloud draw away from us and ascend into heaven.

5. Moses and Elijah came down again from the holy mountain, weeping and lamenting, and said to us: "He has gone up. He has left us."

6. We fell upon our faces again and wept, because our Lord had departed from us.

7. The Lord Jesus Christ was taken from our midst and went up to heaven. And a voice from heaven said: "This is my beloved Son in whom I am well pleased."

8. Many were gathered in his name, proclaimed righteous in his name, sanctified, and their sins were forgiven.

9. Our Lord Jesus Christ said to us before his departure: "I give you authority over serpents and scorpions and over the power of the enemy, and over all manner of disease — and whatever you bind on earth shall be bound in heaven."

10. He also said to us: "Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

11. And know this — as I have said before — the prophets have already spoken concerning everything that I have shown you."

12. We praised and glorified God and went on our way, proclaiming the kingdom of heaven everywhere in his name, preaching repentance and forgiveness of sins throughout all the world.

---

## Textual Notes

- **"He has kept my commandments" (v.1):** This phrase, added to the Matthean/Markan Transfiguration voice, is distinctive to the APE. It frames the Ascension as validation of Jesus's obedience — a christological addition of significance.
- **"Moses and Elijah weeping" (v.5):** A remarkable detail. Even the two heavenly figures who accompanied Christ grieve his departure. The grief is universal.
- **"The generation yet to come" (v.3):** The eschatological generation of the end-times, not the current one. Connects to ch.1's discourse on the fig tree and the last days.
- **Canonical citations (vv.9–11):** The closing commission is woven from Matt 28:18–20, Luke 10:19, and Matt 16:19. The APE ends by inscribing itself within the canonical apostolic tradition.
- **"Preached repentance and forgiveness of sins" (v.12):** Luke 24:47 verbatim. The apocalyptic vision's purpose is missionary proclamation.

---
*SOPHIA synthesis: The Apocalypse of Peter closes with the disciples going into the world to preach — the vision converts into mission. The grief of departure (vv.2, 5–6) is real and unminimized; the commission that follows is authoritative and canonical.*
